newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU reviews Allianz buy of Vereinte.
newsitem.headline: EU reviews Allianz buy of Vereinte.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it had been notified of the proposed control of German insurance firm Vereinte Holding AG by Allianz AG, another German company also active in insurance.
It said in a statement published in the EU's Official Journal that the operation apparently fell under the bloc's merger regulation, which bans creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
The deal was submitted to the Commission for clearance on October 7. The EU executive has one month from that date to clear the agreement or start a four-month in-depth probe.
Allianz chairman Henning Shulte-Noelle said earlier this month he expected the Commission to approve the Vereinte takeover by the end of the year.

The deal is part of a shareholding swap between Allianz and Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG (Munich Re), which also involves the acquisition of Munich Re's subsidiary Hermes by Allianz. This part of the swap deal was cleared by the Commission at the beginning of October.
